message.description: Human-readable message; no tokens, raw diffs, or absolute paths in default output.

envelope_meta.description: Non-normative enumerated-only metadata. Must not carry scores, gates, promotion decisions, secrets, or raw diffs. Prefer omitting meta when empty.

deprecations.description: Optional deprecation notices already mirrored in warnings[] when present.

description: Common --json response envelope for git-cg eval operator commands (S6). stdout carries exactly one envelope document; progress/log chatter stays on stderr. data is command-specific and closed by Slice 2 API-map sketches (envelope keeps data as object). errors[]/warnings[] items are {code, message, hint?}. meta is non-normative enumerated-only (timing/request_id/harness_version/deprecations) and must not carry scores/gates/promotion/secrets/raw diffs.

command.description: Canonical command identity that produced this envelope (e.g. eval doctor, eval run).

ok.description: True when the command completed without envelope-level errors. Independent of product accept / gate.deterministic_pass authority.

data.description: Command-specific payload. Keys are closed by Slice 2 API-map sketches (command-discriminated). Must not smuggle scores/gates/promotion/secrets/raw diffs through undeclared keys or meta.

errors.description: Structured errors; empty array when ok is true in the common success path.

warnings.description: Structured warnings including deprecations in JSON mode.
